issues.summary: The spinner condition uses isSpacesLoading, which includes isFetching, so a background refetch swaps the cached spaces list and invite banners for a spinner (unmounting open invite dialogs).
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: index.tsx:245 was added by this PR, and isSpacesLoading (index.tsx:210) is true whenever isFetching is true, even while currentData still holds cached spaces. Every spaces mutation invalidates the bare 'spaces' tag (AUTO_GENERATED/spaces.ts:25 and others), so accepting or declining an invite refetches the list, the spinner replaces the list, and SpaceListInvite/AcceptInviteDialog unmount in the middle of the flow.

issues.summary: No test covers cached active spaces combined with isFetching=true, which is the case that shows the spinner replacing the list.
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: The new tests in __tests__/SpacesList.test.tsx cover only fetching with no data, the store not hydrated, and cached data with an error. None covers currentData=[space] with isFetching=true, so the regression above goes undetected.

issues.summary: The claim is that Try again hides the cached list.
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: The error/Try-again branch only renders when `error && !spaces?.length` (index.tsx:251), so there is no cached list for a retry to hide.

issues.summary: The claim is that the PR description doesn't record why the Receive icon changed.
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: The PR description links WA-3443 ('Receive button icon changed from QR code to a generic down-left arrow') and explains the swap back to QrCode.

issues.summary: The error copy says 'contact support' but gives no link or route.
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: index.tsx:253 renders plain text with no support link next to it. This is a minor UX gap.

issues.summary: A 401 from /v1/spaces now shows the generic error rather than a re-sign-in prompt.
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: Any error with no cached spaces takes the generic error branch (index.tsx:251). Before this PR it fell through to the misleading empty state, so this is an improvement, and a tailored 401 message would be a nice-to-have.

issues.summary: The new loading and error states have no Storybook story.
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The web guidelines expect stories for UI states, and the PR adds spinner and error branches without one. The behaviour is still covered by unit tests.

issues.summary: Tests assert on styling classes and props (gap-3, data-size='none'), which is brittle.
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The SpacesList.test.tsx tests check for class names and data-size attributes. They break on unrelated restyling and don't catch real visual regressions, but they cost nothing functionally.

issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The element is located via closest('.gap-3'), so the extra negative class check adds almost nothing.

issues.summary: WORKSPACE_BENEFITS is exported only so the test can use it.
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: index.tsx:133 changed to `export const` solely for the test's WORKSPACE_BENEFITS[0]. Matching the literal text would keep the constant private.

issues.summary: The five-branch nested ternary in the render is hard to read.
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: index.tsx:245-296 chains the ternaries. This is a readability preference with no functional cost.
